panels.description:
MRs per author split into Merged, Open, Closed and Draft (top 20). Drafts are open MRs whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP]. MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range per author, split into Merged, Open, Closed and Draft, top 20.
-- GitLab's is_draft is always 0, so an open MR is a Draft when its title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out: those with a "*Created by" description or comment, and those the import
-- account created before July 2021 (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboard A).
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                          AS developer,
       SUM(pr.status = 'MERGED')                               AS Merged,
       SUM(pr.status = 'OPEN' AND NOT (LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])'))         AS Open,
       SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED')                               AS Closed,
       SUM(pr.status = 'OPEN' AND (LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])'))             AS Draft
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY (Merged + Open + Closed + Draft) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: MR Outcomes

panels.description:
MRs per month grouped by review outcome: Approved, Changes Requested, Commented or No Review.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created per month, grouped by the latest review decision from someone other than the author and not a bot:
-- Approved, Changes Requested (a GitLab unapproval), Commented when there are only comments, or No Review.
-- Reviews imported from GitHub ("*Created by <user>* **Review:** Approved") count as decisions on their MR.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are kept on purpose (no not_imported_mr filter).
WITH latest_review AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         pr.created_date,
         (
           SELECT CASE WHEN (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%') OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Changes requested%') THEN 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' WHEN ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Approved%') THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'COMMENTED' END
           FROM pull_request_comments c
           JOIN accounts ca ON ca.id = c.account_id
           WHERE c.pull_request_id = pr.id
             AND (
                  (c.account_id <> pr.author_id AND COALESCE(ca.user_name, '') NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%' AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%'))
               OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Approved%') OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Changes requested%')
             )
           ORDER BY (CASE WHEN (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%') OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Changes requested%') THEN 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' WHEN ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') OR (c.body LIKE '*Created by%**Review:** Approved%') THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'COMMENTED' END <> 'COMMENTED') DESC, c.created_date DESC
           LIMIT 1
         ) AS final_status
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%b %Y')                 AS month,
       SUM(final_status <=> 'APPROVED')                   AS Approved,
       SUM(final_status <=> 'CHANGES_REQUESTED')          AS `Changes requested`,
       SUM(final_status <=> 'COMMENTED')                  AS `Commented only`,
       SUM(final_status IS NULL)                          AS `No review`
FROM latest_review
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY MIN(created_date);

panels.title: Monthly Contributions by MR

panels.description:
Merged MRs as a % of all merged and closed MRs, per author with at least 3. MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Merged MRs as a % of merged plus closed MRs per author, for MRs created in the range, top 20.
-- Authors need at least 3 merged or closed MRs, so a single merged MR does not top the chart at 100%.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out: those with a "*Created by" description or comment, and those the import
-- account created before July 2021 (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboard A).
SELECT developer,
       ROUND(100.0 * Merged / (Merged + Closed), 1) AS `Acceptance Rate`
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')               AS developer,
         SUM(pr.status = 'MERGED')    AS Merged,
         SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED')    AS Closed
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY a.id
) base
WHERE Merged + Closed >= 3
ORDER BY `Acceptance Rate` DESC, (Merged + Closed) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: MR Acceptance Rate

panels.description:
Reviews given per reviewer: Approved, Rejected (change request) or Commented (top 20).
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Per reviewer, the other people's MRs they reviewed, by the latest decision they left on each: Approved, Rejected (a change request,
-- i.e. a GitLab unapproval) or Commented when they only commented, top 20.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         c.pull_request_id,
         CASE WHEN (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%') THEN 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' WHEN ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'COMMENTED' END AS state,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY c.account_id, c.pull_request_id
           ORDER BY (((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') OR (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%')) DESC, c.created_date DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
    AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
    AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
    AND c.account_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                         AS reviewer,
       SUM(rk.state = 'APPROVED')             AS Approved,
       SUM(rk.state = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED')    AS Rejected,
       SUM(rk.state = 'COMMENTED')            AS Commented
FROM ranked rk
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = rk.account_id
WHERE rk.rn = 1
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Contributions by MR Reviews

panels.description:
Median, P75 and P90 days from MR creation to merge, over time.
datasource: pull_requests, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Known, left as is: MRs imported from GitHub are not left out here (no not_imported_mr filter), so ranges before
-- July 2021 include them and they merge within hours.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(pr.merged_date, $interval)                         AS bucket,
         TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) / 1440.0 AS days
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.status      = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND pr.merged_date > pr.created_date
    AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT bucket, days,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket ORDER BY days) AS cd
  FROM d
)
SELECT bucket                                              AS time,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN days END), 2)   AS Median,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.75 THEN days END), 2)   AS P75,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.90 THEN days END), 2)   AS P90
FROM ranked
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Merge Time Trend

panels.description:
Median and P90 hours from MR creation to the first comment or review by someone else (bots excluded).
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- First comment, approval or change request on each MR from someone other than the author and not a bot (e.g. the SonarQube
-- integration), ignoring notes imported from GitHub and AI review-tool output.
-- Known, left as is: MRs imported from GitHub are not left out here (no not_imported_mr filter).
WITH first_touch AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         pr.created_date,
         MIN(c.created_date) AS first_response
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_comments c
    ON c.pull_request_id = pr.id
   AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
   AND c.created_date >= pr.created_date
   AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
  JOIN accounts ca ON ca.id = c.account_id AND COALESCE(ca.user_name, '') NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY pr.id, pr.created_date
),
d AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(created_date, ${interval})                       AS bucket,
         TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_date, first_response) / 60.0    AS hours
  FROM first_touch
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT bucket, hours,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket ORDER BY hours) AS cd
  FROM d
)
SELECT bucket                                               AS time,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN hours END), 2)   AS Median,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.90 THEN hours END), 2)   AS P90
FROM ranked
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Time To First Review

panels.description:
MRs grouped into size bands by lines changed, merge commits excluded. MRs whose commits were not collected (most MRs before 2024, about 1 in 5 since), and environment promotion MRs (e.g. dev -> stage), are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_commits, commits, commit_parents, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MR size is the lines changed across the MR's commits, merge commits excluded. MRs whose commits were not collected are left out,
-- and so are environment promotion MRs (from a branch that at least 20 MRs target, e.g. dev -> stage), which carry hundreds of commits.
-- Known, left as is: MRs imported from GitHub are not left out here (no not_imported_mr filter), so
-- before July 2021 this differs from dashboard A's Average MR Size, which leaves them out.
WITH long_lived_branches AS (
  -- branches that at least 20 MRs target (dev, stage, master, ...); an MR from one of them promotes a whole environment
  SELECT lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  FROM pull_requests lb
  WHERE lb.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
mr_size AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         SUM(c.additions + c.deletions) AS lines_changed
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  JOIN commits c                ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_lived_branches llb WHERE llb.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND llb.base_ref = pr.head_ref)
  GROUP BY pr.id
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN lines_changed <  200 THEN '1. < 200 LOC'
           WHEN lines_changed <  500 THEN '2. 200-499 LOC'
           WHEN lines_changed < 1000 THEN '3. 500-999 LOC'
           ELSE                           '4. 1000+ LOC'
         END      AS bucket,
         COUNT(*) AS mrs
  FROM mr_size
  GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT bucket,
       mrs AS 'MR Count',
       CONCAT(ROUND(100.0 * mrs / SUM(mrs) OVER (), 1), '%') AS Percentage
FROM bucketed
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: MR Size

panels.description:
Open MRs with their age in days, author and reviewers.
datasource: accounts, pull_request_comments, pull_requests, repos, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Open MRs created in the range, oldest first, where the author or one of the reviewers is a selected developer.
-- Reviewers are everyone other than the author, bots excluded, who commented, approved or requested changes.
WITH reviewers AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id,
         c.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
  JOIN accounts ca      ON ca.id = c.account_id AND COALESCE(ca.user_name, '') NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.status = 'OPEN'
    AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
    AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id, c.account_id
)
SELECT r.name                                                      AS 'Repository',
       pr.title                                                    AS 'MR Title',
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pr.created_date)                        AS 'Days Open',
       COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                              AS 'Author',
       (
         SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(ra.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ra.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)') ORDER BY COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(ra.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ra.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)') SEPARATOR ', ')
         FROM reviewers rv
         JOIN accounts ra ON ra.id = rv.account_id
         WHERE rv.pull_request_id = pr.id
       )                                                           AS Reviewers,
       pr.url                                                      AS URL
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN repos r    ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND pr.status = 'OPEN'
  AND (
       pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviewers rv
                WHERE rv.pull_request_id = pr.id
                  AND rv.account_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
ORDER BY `Days Open` DESC;

panels.title: Open MR Aging

panels.description:
Per repo and author, merged MRs with no approval from someone else still standing at merge time (an approval later revoked does not count), and their share of all merged MRs. MRs imported from GitHub (with their imported approvals) are left out.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, repos, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Per repo and author, merged MRs with no approval from anyone other than the author still standing at merge time, and their share of all merged MRs.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out: those with a "*Created by" description or comment, and those the import
-- account created before July 2021 (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboard A).
-- Approvals imported from GitHub (with or without the *Created by marker) only sit on imported MRs, so only GitLab
-- approvals are checked here.
WITH merged AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         pr.base_repo_id,
         pr.author_id,
         NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM pull_request_comments c
           WHERE c.pull_request_id = pr.id
             AND c.created_date <= pr.merged_date
             AND c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED'
             AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
             -- still standing at merge time: the approver did not unapprove afterwards
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments u
                              WHERE u.pull_request_id = pr.id
                                AND u.account_id = c.account_id
                                AND (u.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR u.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%')
                                AND u.created_date > c.created_date
                                AND u.created_date <= pr.merged_date)
         ) AS unapproved
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} )
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT r.name                                                       AS Repository,
       COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                               AS Developer,
       COUNT(*)                                                     AS 'Merged MR Count',
       SUM(m.unapproved)                                            AS 'Unapproved MR Count',
       CONCAT(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.unapproved) / COUNT(*), 1), '%')  AS 'Unapproved MRs Percentage'
FROM merged m
JOIN repos r    ON r.id = m.base_repo_id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = m.author_id
GROUP BY r.id, a.id
ORDER BY `Unapproved MR Count` DESC;

panels.title: MRs Merged Without Approval

list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name

FROM project_mapping pm 
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- MR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- MR reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
)
-- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out
SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
FROM scoped_accounts sa
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
HAVING NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
ORDER BY Name
